host.name: Host
host.desc: Fronts most often. +10% on Home and Work tasks. Switching to the Host in events costs no stress.

protector.name: Protector
protector.desc: Steps up when things get hard. +3% per 10 stress on any task (up to +25%).

caretaker.name: Caretaker
caretaker.desc: Looks after everyone. Halves stress gained on failure. +10% on Self-care tasks.

little.name: Little
little.desc: Young and playful. +20% on Play tasks; successful tasks with a Little reduce stress by 3.

gatekeeper.name: Gatekeeper
gatekeeper.desc: Manages switches. In events, switching fronters costs no stress while a Gatekeeper is on the team.

manager.name: Manager
manager.desc: Keeps things running. +15% on Work tasks; team gets +5% Organization.

social.name: Social
social.desc: Great with people. +15% on Social tasks.

soother.name: Soother
soother.desc: Calms the system. After any task, stress -4.

creative.name: Creative
creative.desc: Artistic soul. +15% on Play and Self-care tasks; team gets +5% Creativity.

memory.name: Memory Holder
memory.desc: Holds history. +15% on Medical and Memory tasks; events with lost time are easier.

fictive.name: Fictive
fictive.desc: Based on a character. Brings borrowed confidence: +6% on every task.

teen.name: Teen
teen.desc: Energetic and stubborn. +15% on Outside tasks.
